overall_feedback: Technical LaTeX gates pass, and R21 numbers, literature coverage, scoped necessity, and limitation centralization are strong. Submission is blocked because the executed live-agent, comparator, and trace protocols depart from the explicitly approved R21 design. The paper also misstates the admission timing boundary and retains author-input placeholders.

comments.title: Live-agent cases L3--L5 do not execute the locked scenarios
comments.quote: L3 requires the returned current version to exceed the certificate pre-version without a further state change; L4--L5 require one failed proposal and equal full canonical database digests
comments.explanation: The approved design requires stale host confirmation and host-confirmation rejection for L3--L5; the reported run performs verification or proposal rejection instead. This is a Stage-0 specification violation.
comments.fix: Execute L3--L5 exactly as locked, regenerate the normalized input, and update Sections 7--9 from those results.

comments.title: Comparator is not the locked same-plan ablation
comments.quote: The comparison therefore isolates validation/planning cost from equivalent persistence; it is not an alternative safe admission path.
comments.explanation: The locked design requires the same atomic persistence plan plus phase timers and bootstrap intervals. The implementation instead uses a generic relational-delta applier, so code-path and SQL-emission differences remain confounded.
comments.fix: Implement the same-plan timed ablation with phase timers and intervals, or remove the isolation claim and formally revise the locked design.

comments.title: Trace comparison violates the locked paired protocol
comments.quote: These are sequential fixed-environment executions rather than paired trials, so the ratios characterize the two recorded runs and are not hardware-independent speedup guarantees.
comments.explanation: The approved R21 design requires identical fixtures and paired invocation order. The manuscript instead adopts a historical baseline and a later sequential run. Honest caveating does not satisfy the locked protocol.
comments.fix: Rerun baseline and optimized trace paths as paired invocations on identical cloned fixtures, then regenerate the comparison and manuscript values.

comments.title: Admission timing description incorrectly includes reverse trace
comments.quote: The full arm executes the review service, complete authority transaction, and a successful post-admission trace.
comments.explanation: The benchmark stops the timer after confirm; QueryForms.trace runs afterward as an untimed validity assertion. The paper therefore misdefines what its admission latency measures.
comments.fix: State that latency times confirmation only and that the successful trace is an untimed post-measurement validity check.

comments.title: Submission PDF still contains author-input placeholders
comments.quote: \authorinput{provide the artifact DOI/URL and confirm access terms before submission}
comments.explanation: The compiled manuscript still exposes unresolved author-controlled placeholders for availability, ethics, authorship, funding, conflicts, acknowledgments, AI disclosure, and the appendix artifact URL.
comments.fix: Replace every authorinput call with approved final text and rebuild before uploading the manuscript.

comments.title: Research-question count is stale
comments.quote: The evaluation addresses seven questions fixed before interpreting the final run:
comments.explanation: The list immediately contains RQ1 through RQ8. This visible count error weakens confidence in revision control.
